visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing an oversized purple t-shirt, sits in a brightly lit room. She excitedly presents a white cardboard shipping box to the camera, gesturing with her hands. Behind her is a white tiered shelf holding plush toys and a modern white floor lamp. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a 7-Eleven promotional box for Chiikawa Lucky Cat figurines. The camera focuses on the printed details like the pre-order date and character illustrations. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the pink and white box colors. (3) The woman uses a small utility knife to cut through the box tape on a wooden desk surface. She opens the lid to reveal four smaller colorful boxes nested inside. Her facial expressions are highly animated, showing wide smiles and raised eyebrows. (4) She proceeds to unbox each figure. First, a white Chiikawa figure is placed on a red cushion with golden legs. She holds it close to the lens to show a golden coin detail. Next, she reveals a blue-eared Hachiware holding a star and an orange Usagi figure. (5) In the final phase, she unveils a special golden-colored figurine, showcasing its shiny finish and the red and white bow on its back. She then lines up all four figurines on the desk for a group shot before waving at the camera while holding the empty boxes.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a high-energy, high-pitched female voice speaking rapidly in Traditional Chinese over a bouncy, major-key electronic BGM. The speaker sounds extremely joyful. (2) A sharp scraping sound occurs as a utility knife cuts cardboard tape, followed by the mid-frequency rustling of box flaps. The BGM maintains a steady, upbeat tempo. (3) Continuous plastic rustling and light clicking sounds are audible as toy packaging is handled. The narrator's voice exhibits high pitch variability and frequent rising intonations, signaling excitement. (4) Occasional 'pop' sound effects are inserted during scene transitions. The narrator provides a close commentary, her voice clearly layered over the persistent background music. (5) The video ends with a series of high-arousal exclamations and laughter, culminating in a bright vocal send-off as the music continues until a final hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Unboxing Process -> Close-up Review -> Final Group Shot -> CTA/Closing
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To share the excitement of receiving a highly-anticipated pre-ordered set of Chiikawa figurines from 7-Eleven and to show off the physical details and quality of the products to followers.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While 7-Eleven and Chiikawa are prominently featured, the tone is that of a personal purchase/gift unboxing rather than a paid sponsorship.
